# apple_game_center_matchmaking_queues (Data Source)

Lists the account's Game Center matchmaking queues.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_game_center_matchmaking_queues" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `queues` (Attributes List) The queues. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--queues))

<a id="nestedatt--queues"></a>
### Nested Schema for `queues`

Read-Only:

- `experiment_rule_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the queue's experiment rule set. Null without one.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the queue.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the queue.
- `rule_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the queue's rule set.
